name: Marmot Amp
tagline: Charging for e-bikes and scooters, minus the parking-garage cosplay.
positioning: Marmot Amp turns your outlet, your building, and 40,000 curbside points into one tidy charging network for the ride you actually own.

hero.h1: Your battery is thirsty. We know a place.
hero.sub: Marmot Amp finds a legit charger near you, remembers where you left off, and stops nagging once your e-bike is full. It's charging for people who ride, not utilities for people who bill.

features.title: One map, every plug
features.description: Home outlet, office bike room, that one café with a suspiciously nice power strip — all in one map, sorted by how far you'd rather not walk.

features.title: Stops at full
features.description: We cut the current when your pack hits 100%, so you stop cooking a cell you paid €600 for. Your future self says a quiet thank you.

features.title: Charged, not pinged
features.description: One notification when it's done. Not four. Not a weekly digest. We are physically incapable of sending a weekly digest.

features.title: Battery health, plainly
features.description: See cycle count, temperature, and true remaining range without a spreadsheet, a forum, or a guy named Dennis.

features.title: Pay per plug, or don't
features.description: Guest sessions bill by the kWh. Your home charger is free forever, obviously — it's your electricity.

features.title: Works with what you have
features.description: E-bikes, scooters, that questionable second-hand moped. If it takes a battery and a plug, it takes Marmot Amp.

testimonials.quote: I used to babysit my charger like a suspicious houseplant. Now it tells me when it's done and shuts itself off. I've reclaimed roughly nine minutes of anxiety per day.
testimonials.name: Priya Vasan

testimonials.quote: I run four delivery scooters out of a garage. Marmot Amp is the first thing I've used that didn't assume I'm a municipal transit authority with a procurement team.
testimonials.name: Tomás Reiner

testimonials.quote: The battery health screen quietly told me one pack was on its last legs before it stranded me on a bridge. That is the entire product, and it's worth it.
testimonials.name: Noor Haddad

pricing.blurb: For the one bike or scooter you actually love.
For the person whose hallway is slowly becoming a garage.
For the prosumer running a small, tasteful fleet.

homepage.footerBlurb: Marmot Amp keeps small electric rides charged, healthy, and out of your anxiety. Built by people who forget to charge things too.
